sentences.text: It is argued by learned counsel for the applicant that pursuant to the order dated 15.03.2022 passed by the Court below, the applicants put up their appearance before the Court below and filed exemption application for their appearance before the Court but the Court below wholly illegally rejected the same and issued non-bailable warrant on 12.05.2023 against the applicants.
It is argued that the punishment in all the aforesaid Sections are below seven years.
It is argued that the applicants are ready and willing to appear before the court below, if the non-bailable warrant shall kept in abeyance by this Court.

4. Considering the above, the non-bailable warrant issued against the applicants in the aforesaid case is kept in abeyance, subject to the condition that the applicants shall appear before the court below on the next date fixed.
5. With the above, the present application is disposed of.
